newsReports.summary: Brighton Hove sets the Premier League two-half pace on 15 points ahead of Arsenal (14 points).
newsReports.social_excerpt:
Brighton Hove Surges to 15 Pts in Premier League DFT Standings Ahead of Arsenal

Brighton Hove sets the Premier League two-half pace on 15 points ahead of Arsenal (14 points).

Read the full multi-league telemetry brief: https://www.diplomantimes.com
newsReports.lead_narrative: Brighton Hove surges to the summit of the Premier League (PL) two-half standings with 15 DFT points as of 2026-11-27, holding a 1-point edge over Arsenal (14 points). Meanwhile, Arsenal leads the standard full-time table on 28 points.
story_body: At the top of the Premier League two-half standings, the leading trio sits at 1. Brighton Hove (15 pts, +7 WP), 2. Arsenal (14 pts, +14 WP), and 3. Bournemouth (14 pts, +4 WP). Brighton Hove holds a 1-point cushion over Arsenal and leads third-placed Bournemouth by 1 points.

The standard full-time standings present a contrasting picture, led by Arsenal (28 pts, +14 WP), Brighton Hove (22 pts, +7 WP), and Man City (22 pts, +10 WP). Arsenal stays 6 points clear of Brighton Hove in full-time points, and Weak Points (STD minus DFT) show the largest positive cushions on Arsenal (+14 WP: 28 STD vs 14 DFT), Man City (+10 WP: 22 STD vs 12 DFT), and Leeds United (+10 WP: 17 STD vs 7 DFT) while Crystal Palace posts the lowest Weak Points tally at +3 WP, reflecting points collected from draws or single-half wins.

At the opposite end of the Premier League two-half table, Man United (2 pts, +6 WP), Sunderland (2 pts, +7 WP), and Nottingham (3 pts, +6 WP) sit under sustained points pressure, while Crystal Palace (7 pts), Man United (8 pts), and Sunderland (9 pts) occupy the lower full-time spots.

Across other tracked top-flight competitions on 2026-11-27, table leaders include Bundesliga (RB Leipzig on 17 two-half pts; Dortmund on 24 full-time pts; max WP: Dortmund +14), Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A (Flamengo on 53 two-half pts; Flamengo on 80 full-time pts; max WP: Cruzeiro +39), Eredivisie (PSV on 27 two-half pts; PSV on 29 full-time pts; max WP: Sittard +14), Ligue 1 (PSG on 15 two-half pts; PSG on 26 full-time pts; max WP: Paris FC +13), La Liga (Barça on 28 two-half pts; Barça on 36 full-time pts; max WP: Real Madrid +16), Primeira Liga (SL Benfica on 18 two-half pts; Porto on 33 full-time pts; max WP: Porto +16), and Serie A (Roma on 23 two-half pts; Lazio on 32 full-time pts; max WP: Inter +18).
